rules.reason: Backed may not offer, sell or deliver xStocks to US persons, and they may only be transferred to non-US persons.
rules.short: xStocks aren't offered to US persons.

rules.reason: You can buy xStocks on the secondary market, but issuance and redemption through Backed are limited to professional investors: a Swiss FinSA Professional Client who is also an EU Qualified Investor if in the EU, or the local equivalent elsewhere. A typical retail holder cannot redeem.
rules.short: You can buy it, but only professional investors can redeem.

rules.reason: Legally a tracker certificate under Swiss law, collateralised by the share. It is not the share itself.
